Tuleva Member Analysis¶

Ad hoc analysis of Tuleva members — AUM, withdrawals, savings behavior, demographics.

Data source: Tuleva's anonymised CRM (Metabase card 2345, analytics.mv_crm), read through the Tuleva agent gateway crm tool. Only aggregates leave the gateway: no individual rows, and any group of fewer than ten people is merged into one unnamed group. Members = everyone with a membership record (active or not).

7. Combined Analysis — What Drives Member Behavior?¶

8. Member Personas¶

Five mutually exclusive segments based on pillar adoption, savings behavior, and engagement:

  • Gone: no AUM left in any Tuleva fund
  • Power Saver: both pillars, voluntary II pillar rate (> 2%) and at least 2,400 EUR into III pillar in the last 12 months
  • Steady Saver: both pillars, and either a voluntary rate or some III pillar contributions
  • Coaster: both pillars, 2% rate and no III pillar contributions
  • Single Pillar: everyone else with AUM (only one pillar)

"Both pillars" = active in TUK75 or TUK00, and III pillar AUM > 0.

--- POWER SAVER (2,610 members, 26%) — "The backbone of Tuleva" ---
  Typical: 44 years (mean), earns 5,195 EUR/month (mean), 104K in AUM (mean)
  Behavior: Maximizes everything: voluntary II pillar rate and 2,400+ EUR/year into III pillar (on average 5,311 EUR). Only 7% have ever left.

--- STEADY SAVER (3,793 members, 38%) — "The reliable middle" ---
  Typical: 44 years (mean), earns 3,412 EUR/month (mean), 56K in AUM (mean)
  Behavior: Active in both pillars but saves less intensely. 64% chose a voluntary higher rate, 81% contribute to III pillar (~1,713 EUR/year). 17% have left.

--- COASTER (777 members, 8%) — "Signed up but checked out" ---
  Typical: 43 years (mean), earns 3,083 EUR/month (mean), 38K in AUM (mean)
  Behavior: Has both pillars but does the minimum: 2% rate, no III pillar contributions in the last 12 months. 35% have left Tuleva.

--- SINGLE PILLAR (1,807 members, 18%) — "Half in, half out" ---
  Typical: 47 years (mean), earns 3,571 EUR/month (mean), 35K in AUM (mean)
  Behavior: Only one pillar with Tuleva. 60% of them hold III pillar only. 24% have left.

--- GONE (927 members, 9%) — "Left but still on the books" ---
  Typical: 49 years (mean), earns 2,958 EUR/month (mean), 0K in AUM (mean)
  Behavior: Withdrew or transferred all assets. 57% formally left via early withdrawal or transfer.

Method notes¶

The row-level card 2259 used in the first version (February 2026) is no longer readable: Metabase is read only through the agent gateway, which answers aggregates, never rows. This version is built on aggregates of the same CRM view, with the same groups. Differences from the February version:

  • Means instead of medians where a group is put together from several gateway cells (savings groups, personas, salary groups): medians cannot be combined, sums and counts can. Single-fund medians (section 2, III pillar contributions) are still medians.
  • Total AUM per member is approximate: the card has no total-AUM column, so members are counted in a TUK75 × III pillar grid and each grid cell is put in the total-AUM bucket of its average. Members near a bucket edge can land in the neighbouring bucket. The concentration curve is built the same way and slightly understates concentration.
  • "II after pension age + III redeemed" is now its own withdrawal group (in February those members were left out of the table, so its shares did not add up to 100%).
  • Savings rate in the savings paradox chart is the group's mean contribution divided by its mean annual salary, not the mean of individual rates.
  • Groups of fewer than ten people are hidden by the gateway; see the count below.
